findings.title: Remote runtime's mid-launch gateway-restart recovery path never reconnects to the host
findings.description: In FactoryRemoteAttemptRuntime.open(), when launches.claimStart(attemptId) returns claimed:false (the row is already 'launching'/'launched'/'uncertain' from a prior, possibly-crashed open() call, and no terminal result exists yet), the method returns disposition 'attached' immediately via `return this.settled(claim.intent, "attached", () => this.durable(attemptId, ...))` WITHOUT ever calling `this.options.transport.attach()`. This is inconsistent with (a) the same file's own lost-launch-response handler four lines below (lines 52-58), which does call `this.options.transport.attach(tokened)` before giving up, and (b) the in-process IsolatedFactoryAttemptRuntime.attached() (src/factory/runner/attempt-runtime.ts, ~652-672), which always physically reattaches via `runner.attach()` before returning. Practical effect: when the attempt-dispatch driver's queue redelivers an attempt after a gateway restart (FactoryAttemptDispatcher -> IsolatedFactoryTrustedRunner.run() -> runtime.open()) and the row is stuck mid-launch, the remote deployment reports outcome_unknown immediately with no attempt to learn the guest's true state from the host, even if the host is still reachable and the guest is alive or already finished.
findings.reproduction: grep every `claimStart` call site: only src/factory/host-launch-transport.integration.test.ts:167 calls it directly to simulate a restarted supervisor, and it bypasses FactoryRemoteAttemptRuntime.open() entirely (calls store.claimStart + client.attach at the transport layer, not through the runtime). No test calls open() a second time on a row left in 'launching'/'launched' state to exercise remote-attempt-runtime.ts:38-39.
findings.plan_reference: docs/plans/2026-09-13-composable-factory-platform-completion.md W01 pass criteria: "Prove both recovery topologies: a restarted/moved gateway reconnects to the same host supervisor" -- proven for supervisor restart (via direct store/client calls) and for gateway restart AFTER completion (terminal result already recorded), but not for gateway restart DURING an in-flight remote launch through the actual runtime API.
findings.recommendation: In the !claim.claimed branch, call `this.options.transport.attach(claim.intent)` before falling back to a durable-only read, mirroring the lost-launch-response handler in the same file. Add a test that leaves a row in 'launching' state and calls open() again, asserting it reconnects (attaches: 1, no second start) rather than immediately reporting uncertain.
findings.gate_overstatement: G4's EXPECT line says 'exactly one physical start, one invocation, and one broker effect across every failure' -- true for the three specific scenarios its EVIDENCE lists (lost launch response, supervisor restart, gateway restart after completion), but broader than what is proven; this specific scenario is unproven, not merely undocumented.
